items.text: Entitlement path: Conditional Use Authorization for bar use + Type 42 license (transfer or new application with PCN finding) + Place of Entertainment permit, in parallel with building permit and health permit Estimated time: 210 to 450 days. Estimated government cost: $8,300 to $26,000. Notes: The critical path is the Conditional Use Authorization (120–300 days per catalog entry, realistically 6–10 months including pre-application meeting, community outreach, environmental review, Commission hearing, and 30-day appeal period). The CUA application fee is $3,100+ (2026–27 rate for no construction; higher if tenant improvements exceed thresholds). In parallel, the ABC Type 42 license will take 60–150 days if a transfer from another bar within the Mission Alcohol SUD is available, or 90–240 days if ABC flags undue concentration and the City must issue a Public Convenience or Necessity finding (likely, given 9 on-sale licenses within 500 ft). If no transferable Type 42 exists within the SUD, the bar use cannot proceed under current zoning unless Planning issues a written exemption. The Place of Entertainment permit (45–120 days, $2,708 application fee in 2026–27) can be filed after the CUA is approved or in late stages; Entertainment Commission will want zoning confirmation. Building permit plan review (2–4 months, $800–15,000 depending on scope) and DPH plan check + health permit (21–60 days plan check, 14–45 days final permit; $828–2,500 plan check, $470 permit application in 2026–27) run in parallel with the CUA. Total government fees (excluding ABC license purchase if transferring): CUA $3,100, POE $2,708, DPH plan check + health permit $1,298–2,970, building permit $800–15,000, business registration $55–700, other state/federal $0 (EIN, seller's permit, RBS, workers' comp quotes vary), sign permit $300–1,500 = approximately $8,300–$26,000. Timeline is 7–15 months from CUA filing to opening, with the CUA hearing as the long pole; if the CUA is denied or the Type 42 transfer requirement cannot be met, the concept cannot open as a bar. The two withdrawn bar CUAs within 1,000 ft (2010.0680C, 2017-013728CUA) signal approval risk, though the records do not state why applicants withdrew. Budget contingency time and legal/consultant fees for the CUA and ABC undue-concentration response.
